name: NOT_FOUND
description: The batch names feature 8, which does not exist. The whole batch must fail with this gRPC status and apply no edit. The update to 42 and the delete of 7 must not happen: the runners read 7 and 42 back with feature_apply_edits_missing_target_verify_request.json and require feature_apply_edits_missing_target_verify_response.json exactly.
